name: Alt梦魇救赎
detailed_description:
Horror Adventure Puzzle Game - ALT: Nightmare Redemption

The setting of this work is a fictional society in the 2020s, which resembles our world but is not quite the same.

The characters collide with each other as they navigate societal pressures and their own growth journeys while striving for self-realization.

You will join the protagonist in exploring various events and mysteries, traversing different storylines, gradually unraveling the truth behind unresolved cases through investigation and interaction with objects or people within scenes.

A series of explosions occurred at the deep-sea drilling platform under the jurisdiction of Elybrugh City by the sea. The seabed pipeline ruptured, causing a large amount of crude oil to leak, gradually staining the city black from the coastline. Secondary disasters displaced many people. Under the joint investigation of Morrison, an officer at Elybrugh Police Department, and his friend Mentha—a lawyer—the cause of the incident seems to point towards St.Anthony's Juvenile Academy—an institution represented by Professor Freeman, a giant in neurosurgery, aimed at addressing increasing juvenile delinquency and psychological issues in society annually.

At the same time, psychiatrist Marine and her assistant Felix make an emergency visit to Egas Psychiatric Hospital for her important patient Edward on Christmas Eve, but they get caught up in a crisis...

Through the performance and metaphors in the game process, you will gradually understand the full story alongside the protagonist as you navigate through intertwined plots. The game includes various forms of presentation, allowing you to comprehend the truth about characters and plot from different perspectives.
